title: Universally subtrusive morphisms of schemes on affine tests
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism. Give the points of any scheme $Z$ their local constructible topology: a subset $E\subseteq |Z|$ is open if and only if, for every affine open $U\subseteq Z$, its inverse image in $U$ is open for the topology generated by quasi-compact opens and their complements [def-weil-pbc-constructible-topology]. Equivalently this is the final topology of the inclusions of all affine open charts carrying their constructible topologies. Say that $f$ is universally subtrusive if for every affine scheme $T$ and map $g:T\to Y$, the projection $p:X\times_Y T\to T$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a quotient map for these local constructible topologies (in particular surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism]), and every Zariski specialization pair $t_0\in\overline{\{t_1\}}$ in $T$ lifts to $x_0\in\overline{\{x_1\}}$ in $X\times_Y T$ with $p(x_i)=t_i$. All test schemes lie in the same scheme universe as $X,Y$.

source.place: Section 1, Proposition (1.2)(v); Proposition (2.1)(i), Definition (2.2), Proposition (2.4); affine-test formulation in the refinement node.
